ladder_rules.lead: An observation, oddity or idea with a source. No prediction and kill condition yet.
ladder_rules.hypothesis: Needs a prediction and a kill condition. A preregistered fail-closed verdict rule counts as a kill condition; kill_source says which kind.
ladder_rules.thesis: Needs surviving named opposition and a decisive observation. The rival and the observation are named in the row.
ladder_rules.conjecture: Needs a precise statement and checks. Checks are not proof.
ladder_rules.theorem: Needs a proof of the intended statement, on file. A proof of a nearby statement does not count.
ladder_rules.law candidate: Law cannot be self-awarded. It needs independent replication across domains by others. Ours is at most law candidate, and it needs that replication in hand.
ladder_rules.killed: The statement or the hypothesis behind it failed its own test, or the test was void at the kill. The row keeps its finding. Killed claims stay listed.
